# Packages

```{r packages}

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
source(here::here("code", "aps_figure_helpers.R"))

```

# Data

```{r data}

# all multiverse performance metrics, one row per participant
metrics_wide <- read_csv(
  "../../data/processed/example hayes2020/data_processed_participant_level.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# scr predictor 1: bad (A+B) minus good (C+D) deck scr difference
scr_deck <- read_csv(
  "../../data/raw/example hayes2020/scr_deck_diffs.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename(scr_deck_diff = log_fSCR_Z) %>%
  select(id, scr_deck_diff)

# scr predictor 2: mixed-outcome minus gain-only outcome scr difference
scr_outcome <- read_csv(
  "../../data/raw/example hayes2020/scr_outcome_diffs.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename(scr_outcome_diff = log_fSCR_Z) %>%
  select(id, scr_outcome_diff)

analysis_data <- metrics_wide %>%
  left_join(scr_deck,    by = "id") %>%
  left_join(scr_outcome, by = "id")

```

## Data overview

```{r data-overview}

cat("Participants:", nrow(analysis_data), "\n")
cat("Metric columns (before filtering):", ncol(metrics_wide) - 1, "\n")

# list the metric columns without id and zero-variance columns
zero_var_cols <- metrics_wide %>%
  select(-id) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "col", values_to = "sd") %>%
  filter(sd == 0 | is.na(sd)) %>%
  pull(col)

metric_cols <- setdiff(names(metrics_wide), c("id", zero_var_cols))

cat("Zero-variance columns excluded:", length(zero_var_cols),
    paste0("(", paste(zero_var_cols, collapse = ", "), ")"), "\n")
cat("Metrics entering correlations:", length(metric_cols), "\n")

```

# Correlations

```{r correlations}

run_cor <- function(x, y) {
  test <- cor.test(x, y, method = "pearson")
  tibble(r = test$estimate, p = test$p.value)
}

cor_results <- map_dfr(metric_cols, function(col) {
  d <- run_cor(analysis_data[[col]], analysis_data$scr_deck_diff)
  o <- run_cor(analysis_data[[col]], analysis_data$scr_outcome_diff)
  tibble(
    metric    = col,
    r_deck    = d$r,
    p_deck    = d$p,
    r_outcome = o$r,
    p_outcome = o$p
  )
})

```

# Results

## Summary

```{r summary}

n_metrics   <- nrow(cor_results)
sig_deck    <- sum(cor_results$p_deck    < .05, na.rm = TRUE)
sig_outcome <- sum(cor_results$p_outcome < .05, na.rm = TRUE)
sig_both    <- sum(cor_results$p_deck < .05 & cor_results$p_outcome < .05, na.rm = TRUE)
sig_neither <- sum(cor_results$p_deck >= .05 & cor_results$p_outcome >= .05, na.rm = TRUE)
sign_flip   <- sum(sign(cor_results$r_deck) != sign(cor_results$r_outcome), na.rm = TRUE)

tibble(
  `Total metrics`                           = n_metrics,
  `SCR deck: p < .05`                       = sig_deck,
  `SCR outcome: p < .05`                    = sig_outcome,
  `Both significant`                        = sig_both,
  `Neither significant`                     = sig_neither,
  `Sign differs between predictors`         = sign_flip
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Summary of correlation results across all multiverse metrics") %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE)

```

## Rank of the originally reported scoring strategy

```{r original-metric-rank}

# hayes & wedell (2020) scored the igt as the logit of the c+d choice proportion
original_metric <- "C_plus_D_log_transform"

ranked_results <- cor_results %>%
  mutate(
    rank_deck    = rank(-abs(r_deck),    ties.method = "min"),
    rank_outcome = rank(-abs(r_outcome), ties.method = "min")
  )

original_rank <- ranked_results %>%
  filter(metric == original_metric)

rank_deck           <- original_rank$rank_deck
rank_outcome        <- original_rank$rank_outcome
n_stronger_deck     <- rank_deck    - 1
n_stronger_outcome  <- rank_outcome - 1

cat(sprintf(
  paste(
    "The originally reported scoring strategy reproduced Hayes and Wedell's",
    "correlations exactly. It ranked %d of %d metrics for the deck contrast",
    "and %d of %d for the outcome contrast, so only %d and %d alternative scoring",
    "strategies would have yielded a stronger association (see Fig. 3).\n"
  ),
  rank_deck, n_metrics, rank_outcome, n_metrics, n_stronger_deck, n_stronger_outcome
))

```

## Distributions of r values

```{r r-distributions, fig.height=4, fig.width=9}

# r values for Hayes & Wedell's metric, shaped to match the facet variable
authors_r <- cor_results %>%
  filter(metric == "C_plus_D_log_transform") %>%
  select(r_deck, r_outcome) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "r_var", values_to = "r") %>%
  mutate(predictor = recode(r_var,
    r_deck    = "SCR bad vs. good decks contrast",
    r_outcome = "SCR mixed vs. gains contrast"
  ))

cor_results %>%
  select(metric, r_deck, r_outcome) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(r_deck, r_outcome), names_to = "predictor", values_to = "r") %>%
  mutate(predictor = recode(predictor,
    r_deck    = "SCR bad vs. good decks contrast",
    r_outcome = "SCR mixed vs. gains contrast"
  )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(r, fill = predictor)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0, alpha = 0.8, colour = NA) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(data = authors_r, aes(xintercept = r),
             colour = "#D55E00", linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ predictor) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#E69F00"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.25)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of r values across all multiverse metrics",
    x = "Pearson r",
    y = "Number of metrics"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```

## Full results table

Sorted by SCR bad-good deck |r|, largest first.

```{r results-table}

cor_results %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(r_deck))) %>%
  mutate(
    r_deck_fmt    = sprintf("%.3f%s", r_deck,    if_else(p_deck    < .05, "*", "")),
    p_deck_fmt    = sprintf("%.3f",   p_deck),
    r_outcome_fmt = sprintf("%.3f%s", r_outcome, if_else(p_outcome < .05, "*", "")),
    p_outcome_fmt = sprintf("%.3f",   p_outcome)
  ) %>%
  select(metric, r_deck_fmt, p_deck_fmt, r_outcome_fmt, p_outcome_fmt) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Metric", "r", "p", "r", "p"),
    caption   = paste0(
      "Pearson correlations between all multiverse IGT metrics and SCR predictors (N = 64). ",
      "* p < .05. Sorted by |r| for SCR bad-good deck predictor."
    )
  ) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "SCR bad-good decks" = 2, "SCR mixed-gains" = 2))

```

## Scatter: r values across predictors

```{r scatter, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}

# significance category per metric, r values without the cor names attribute
fig3_data <- cor_results %>%
  mutate(
    r_deck       = unname(r_deck),
    r_outcome    = unname(r_outcome),
    significance = case_when(
      p_deck < .05 & p_outcome < .05 ~ "Both",
      p_deck < .05                   ~ "Deck Contrast Only",
      p_outcome < .05                ~ "Outcome Contrast Only",
      TRUE                           ~ "Neither"
    ),
    significance = factor(significance, levels = c("Both", "Deck Contrast Only",
                                                   "Outcome Contrast Only", "Neither"))
  )

write_csv(fig3_data, "KuelpmannFig3_data.csv")

# hayes and wedell original metric and the position of its label
original <- fig3_data %>%
  filter(metric == "C_plus_D_log_transform")
label_xy <- c(x = 0.60, y = 0.82)

fig3 <- ggplot(fig3_data, aes(r_deck, r_outcome, colour = significance)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
  annotate("segment", x = label_xy[["x"]] - 0.04, y = label_xy[["y"]] - 0.11,
           xend = original$r_deck + 0.01, yend = original$r_outcome + 0.03,
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = original, aes(r_deck, r_outcome), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             shape = 21, size = 1.8, fill = "#0072B2", colour = "black", stroke = 1.1) +
  annotate("text", x = label_xy[["x"]], y = label_xy[["y"]],
           label = "C + D Logit\n(Hayes & Wedell, 2020b)",
           family = font_family, size = 9 / .pt, lineheight = 0.95, vjust = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = expression("Significant at " * italic(p) * " < .05"),
    values = c("Both" = "#0072B2", "Deck Contrast Only" = "#D55E00",
               "Outcome Contrast Only" = "#E69F00", "Neither" = "grey60")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.5), labels = label_minus(1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.5), labels = label_minus(1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = c(-1.05, 1.05), ylim = c(-1.05, 1.05)) +
  labs(
    x = expression(italic(r) * " With SCR Deck Contrast (Disadvantageous vs. Advantageous)"),
    y = expression(italic(r) * " With SCR Outcome Contrast (Mixed vs. Gains)")
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5))) +
  theme_aps() +
  theme(
    legend.position        = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.99),
    legend.justification   = c(0, 1),
    legend.key.height      = unit(10, "pt"),
    legend.spacing.y       = unit(1, "pt")
  )

fig3

save_figure(fig3, "KuelpmannFig3", width = 5, height = 5)

```
